title: Snapshot decoder
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, and let $l$ be a finite list of Boolean values. The snapshot decoded from $l$ is the value of the inverse of the snapshot encoding of $M$ applied to $l$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet
